name: Bahawalnagar

queries.query: Bahawalnagar Pakistan official cadastral map parcel land records Punjab PULSE PLRA
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE) viewer, which lists Bahawalnagar under Cadastral Maps, the Punjab Land Records Authority, the Punjab Cities Program municipal GIS map page, and the official Bahawalnagar municipal base map. PULSE configuration exposed a public ArcGIS MapServer Feature Layer for Bahawalnagar; bounded anonymous metadata and ID-plus-geometry query succeeded.

queries.query: بہاولنگر پاکستان سرکاری کادسٹرل نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ پارسل پنجاب
queries.result: پہلی فریق کی تلاش میں پنجاب کے سرکاری PULSE ناظر میں بہاولنگر کے لیے Cadastral Maps، پنجاب لینڈ ریکارڈز اتھارٹی، پنجاب سٹیز پروگرام کا میونسپل GIS صفحہ، اور میونسپل بہاولنگر کا سرکاری نقشہ ملا۔ PULSE کی موجودہ JavaScript/configuration سے بہاولنگر کا عوامی ArcGIS Feature Layer ملا؛ محدود نامعلوم metadata اور ID-plus-geometry درخواست کامیاب ہوئی۔

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Municipal Corporation Bahawalnagar is evidenced by its official services-map page and city base-map publication; the base map is cartographic context and not the queried parcel API.
officialSourceAssessment.stateParcelService: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE), Punjab Land Records Authority, official viewer at https://lis.pulse.gop.pk/.
officialSourceAssessment.parcelService: Punjab Government ArcGIS REST service https://gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis/rest/services/VendorMaps/Punjab_Cdastral_Maps/MapServer, layer 1 named Bahawalnagar.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A first-party Punjab cadastral viewer explicitly lists Bahawalnagar and its current configuration points to a Bahawalnagar polygon Feature Layer with anonymous query capability. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery; it does not admit a runtime adapter.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: Bahawalnagar-specific first-party cadastral layer and a successful bounded safe ID-plus-geometry response were obtained.

schemaAndCrs.responseType: ArcGIS Feature Layer query returned GeoJSON
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:4326 in retained GeoJSON; native layer sourceSpatialReference is EPSG:3857/Web Mercator (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857)
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: OBJECTID, observed as ArcGIS OID and used as canonical retained id
schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: Layer metadata was inspected, but only OBJECTID and geometry were requested in the retained parcel query. Raw source attribute sets are not retained. The layer advertises maxRecordCount 2000 and supports JSON/GeoJSON queries.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: A 0.01-degree WGS84 envelope centered on the exact WUP point [29.9959528945948, 73.254876513403] intersected the layer and returned three polygons. The point was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Punjab PULSE Bahawalnagar cadastral Feature Layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The layer extent is approximately 79.0324866,33.7385433 to 82.3367839,35.5065190 in EPSG:3857; the successful query verifies only the bounded area around the WUP point and does not establish citywide completeness.

serialReviewerQualification: required; this research packet is not source integration or runtime admission
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [29.9959528945948, 73.254876513403] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The bounded query returned three nearby/intersecting polygons, not a citywide extract; no completeness or absence claim is made.
The ArcGIS service required the viewer's public application token for REST requests; no credentials or private token was used, and the token was not retained in artifacts.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The first-party PULSE viewer and Bahawalnagar-specific ArcGIS layer are clearly evidenced, with native OBJECTID and polygon geometry verified in a bounded query. Citywide coverage, parcel completeness, and runtime adapter suitability remain for independent serial review.
